task_summary: Run GLM to simulate Lake Mendota vertical water temperature (2009-2015) with RMSE < 2°C against field observations.
decomposition_rationale: Single cohesive workflow: configure namelist, execute GLM, parse NetCDF, compare to observations, and iterate calibration. One skill keeps these tightly-coupled steps together with shared utilities.

skills.name: evo-glm-simulation
skills.description: Utility skill for running General Lake Model (GLM) simulations: edit glm3.nml namelist parameters, execute the GLM binary, parse NetCDF output with dynamic Lagrangian layers, match to field observations, compute RMSE, and iteratively calibrate key parameters (Kw, wind_factor, coef_mix_hyp, lw_factor, ch) to achieve RMSE < 2°C.
skills.responsibility: End-to-end GLM workflow: namelist I/O, subprocess execution, NetCDF parsing with depth conversion (lake_depth - z), observation matching/interpolation, RMSE computation, and calibration loop.
dr_sections: 3. Python Libraries for Reading/Writing Fortran Namelists
6. Observation Data Matching and RMSE Computation
